name: only-one-chat
description: Coordinate multiple AI coding agents through one shared conversation.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted folder the panel opens, but no agent runs.

onlyOneChat.leader.cli.description: CLI of the leader, the model you chat with. A chat keeps its providers: another CLI applies from the next chat.

onlyOneChat.leader.model.description: Model of the leader, as its CLI names it; chosen in the Ruoli view from the models the CLI offers.

onlyOneChat.leader.effort.description: Reasoning effort of the leader, among those its model supports.

enumDescriptions: Reads only: no file changes, no commands that write.
Asks you before acting: Codex before any command it does not know to be safe; Claude before any edit or command not allowed.
Acts inside the folder; asks you to go beyond it.
onlyOneChat.leader.permission.description: What the leader may do without asking. Changed in the Ruoli view, it applies from the role's next turn, in the same session.

enumDescriptions: Reads only: no file changes, no commands that write.
Asks you before acting: Codex before any command it does not know to be safe; Claude before any edit or command not allowed.
Acts inside the folder; asks you to go beyond it.
onlyOneChat.implementer.permission.description: What the implementer may do without asking. Changed in the Ruoli view, it applies from the role's next turn, in the same session.

onlyOneChat.implementer.cli.description: CLI of the implementer, which makes the changes. A chat keeps its providers: another CLI applies from the next chat.

onlyOneChat.implementer.model.description: Model of the implementer, as its CLI names it; chosen in the Ruoli view from the models the CLI offers.

onlyOneChat.implementer.effort.description: Reasoning effort of the implementer, among those its model supports.

onlyOneChat.approvalMode.description: manual: you approve each message between agents; auto: they pass, logged.

onlyOneChat.leaderReview.description: After a delegation: always, the leader reviews the report at once; deferred, it reads it with your next message (one leader turn less).

onlyOneChat.codexPath.description: Path of the Codex executable; empty: searched on PATH.

onlyOneChat.claudePath.description: Path of the Claude Code executable; empty: searched on PATH.

onlyOneChat.allowedCommands.description: Programs Claude may run without asking, for example to run the tests.

onlyOneChat.verifyCommand.description: Run again by the extension after each delegation, e.g. ["python", "-m", "unittest"].

onlyOneChat.fake.description: Development host only: fake CLIs, no model turns, no quota.

onlyOneChat.leader.instructions.description: Your own instructions for the leader, added to its role instructions. Applies from the next chat. Project rules belong in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, which the CLIs already read.

onlyOneChat.implementer.instructions.description: Your own instructions for the implementer, added to its role instructions. Applies from the next chat.

onlyOneChat.composer.enterSends.description: Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line; off: Ctrl+Enter sends and Enter starts a new line.

enumDescriptions: Asks to save the unsaved files of the folder before a message.
Never: the agents see the files as they are on disk.
onlyOneChat.saveBeforeSend.description: Unsaved files of the folder before a message: the agents read and change the files on disk.

onlyOneChat.notifications.waiting.description: A notification when an agent waits for you and the chat is not in view.

onlyOneChat.notifications.turnEnd.description: A notification when a message is done and the chat is not in view.

onlyOneChat.notifications.usageThreshold.description: A warning when a usage window of a subscription goes past this percentage; 0: never.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p webview/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
